headline: Public hearings on Stop & Shop signs at 2265 Northampton Street, parking at 61-69 Suffolk Street, and a zone change at 172 Sargeant Street.
summary: Public hearings cover sign and parking requests, a fence height request, and three zone changes. Other business includes a Cassella amendment and the tentative meeting schedule.
items: Stop & Shop: increase in sign size and number of signs, 2265 Northampton Street (SP 2026-13)
Bryan Taub: reduce parking requirements, 61-69 Suffolk Street (SP 2026-14)
Rafael and Sheila Rivera: continued request to exceed fence height, 230-232 Beech Street (SP 2026-7)
Irfan Raheel: continued zone change, 172 Sargeant Street, from BG to DR (ZC 2026-6)
Panitch, Thalheimer, Purcell: continued zone change to Section 6.4.6, BG Signs (ZC 2026-7)
Magrath: continued zone change for native plants (ZC 2026-4)
Alan Fini: ANR plan, 2 Fini Road (179-00-003)
Cassella: site plan review amendment, 686 Main Street (Amendment #2 TBD)
Tentative meeting schedule for September and October 2026
